summary: Substrate/security P3 residual (changes_product=0): two intra-tenant leaks flagged by the T-0739 judge. NB-2 (per-hop READ-PDP on GET /api/records/:id/links) FIXED. NB-1 (cross-employee throughput in operational-analytics) ASSESSED and FLAGGED as a product-policy question — deliberately NOT built.

nb2_fix.approach: Per-hop RECORD-level READ-PDP added to the cross-app hop fetcher. The SOURCE record was already gated (T-0739); the LINKED TARGET records in the response were returned with fields as-stored, gated only by tenant RLS -> any grant-holder who could read the source also saw the fields/id/existence of every linked target inside the tenant, even targets they held NO READ grant on. makeHopFetcher now (a) JOINs registry_def to obtain application_id, then (b) applies isRecordReadable(RowAncestry, grants, ancestry, nowMs) to the target before its fields are projected. The visibility (grants+ancestry) is resolved ONCE per request by the existing resolveReadVisibility and threaded through resolveLinksForRecord -> makeHopFetcher (NF-1). Honest-degrade (NF-2): resolver absent (test-only) -> per-hop gate skipped, byte-identical to pre-fix behavior; the pre-existing 3-arg callers and pure unit tests keep compiling and exercising the un-gated path.
nb2_fix.resolver_reused: isRecordReadable + resolveReadVisibility (ReadVisibilityResolver/ReportAggReadVisibilityResolver instance from src/core/read-visibility.ts) — the SAME canonical single resolver T-0570 (records.ts GET /api/records/:id), T-0632 (report-page-render.ts), T-0721/T-0722 (processes), and the T-0739 source gate use. No new resolver, no second authority path. Frozen READ-PDP core (grant-lattice/object-handle/grant-resolver/field-visibility) byte-unchanged.
nb2_fix.redact_vs_omit: OPAQUE-REDACT collapsed to `not_found` (NOT literal omit, NOT a distinct `no_grant`). Justification: (1) the resolveHop core contract ALWAYS returns exactly one projection per cross_app_ref DEFINITION and never omits — literal omission would fork that contract; the denied projection carries only the schema-level DEFINITION label + refField key, never the target record's id or field VALUES, so nothing record-specific leaks. (2) Collapsing not-readable -> `not_found` (the SAME reason as an absent target) is the FR-5 existence-indistinguishability pattern the T-0739 source gate and records.ts GET already use: returning a distinct `no_grant` would let an attacker distinguish 'record exists but hidden' from 'record absent' — an existence-leak. Collapse-to-not_found achieves the SAME existence-hiding the task credited to 'omit', while staying consistent with the existing hop-denial machinery (not_found/cross_tenant/dangling_ref already return opaque redacted projections). FIELD-level redaction WITHIN a readable target (T-0081 roleFieldVisibility) remains a correctly-scoped FUTURE — orthogonal to this record-level gate.

nb1_finding_text: Любой активный сотрудник с любым грантом (то есть практически каждый — из-за default-open role-reader бэкфилла миграций 117/124) видит в «Оперативной аналитике» (top_actors / нагрузка по исполнителям) производительность ВСЕХ сотрудников тенанта поимённо: кто сколько переходов/задач выполнил. Сейчас это защищено только вход-гейтом «≥1 подтверждённый грант» (= активное членство в тенанте, ратифицировано T-0739 как tenant-uniform observability — тот же класс, что реестр сотрудников org.ts и расходы spend.ts «any tenant member»). Вопрос продукта/владельца: нужен ли гейт по управленческой авторитетности — должен ли рядовой сотрудник видеть производительность коллег и руководителей, или «Топ исполнителей» должен быть сужен до подчинённых/своей орг-ветки (либо доступен только ролям с управленческой привилегией)? Это НЕ технический баг и НЕ тот же класс, что NB-2: готового предиката авторитетности «кто вправе видеть чужую производительность» в системе НЕТ (проверено grep: isManagerOf/reportsTo/subordinate отсутствуют; есть только isGenesisOwner — владелец, всё-или-ничего, и org-ancestry — структурная иерархия, не ратифицированная модель видимости аналитики, к тому же top_actors включает акторов-агентов, а не только сотрудников под орг-узлом). Сужение изменит текущую ратифицированную tenant-uniform семантику — это продуктовое поведение, а не заделка утечки. Кандидат на эскалацию владельцу (граница эскалации: продукт).
nb1_why_not_built: No clean existing manager/authority predicate to reuse (verified by grep — only isGenesisOwner owner-level + structural org-ancestry exist). Gating cross-employee throughput would require inventing a new permission model ('who may see whose productivity'), would silently change the T-0739-ratified tenant-uniform observability semantics (peer class: spend.ts / org.ts roster), and would not cover agent actors present in top_actors. Genuine product/founder decision, not a mechanical leak-plug — left unfixed per task instruction.
